findings.summary: The test run leaves out athena-cap-change, whose prompt the plan edits.
findings.evidence: crates/athena-cap-change/src/lib.rs:26 loads prompts/verifier.md with include_str!, and that crate has its own tests (lib.rs:172-178). The plan runs only `cargo test -p athena-context`. Fix: Also run `cargo test -p athena-cap-change`, or run `cargo test --workspace --no-run` followed by the affected crates' tests, so the edit to the change prompt is tested too.

findings.summary: The shared brief and verifier prompt also reach study verifiers, so the wording must suit them.
findings.evidence: verifier_brief in athena-context is the common brief builder. crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs:31 has its own verifier prompt, but study verifiers also get the shared athena-context verifier.md and the shared checks section. Text that says 'never rerun the full `cargo test` suite' would reach study verifiers as well, and changes to the study verifier are out of scope. Fix: Word the brief paragraph and the shared prompt so they hold for any capability (for example, 'the checks listed above are recorded for this candidate; do not rerun them or the full test suite'). Say in decisions.md that the study verifier gets this text through the shared brief, and that study's own prompt is unchanged.

findings.summary: Whether verify.rs changes is left open, which makes criterion 6's file check unclear.
findings.evidence: verify.rs:54-56 already documents that reuse_statement yields text only when the SHA matches. A further doc-comment adds little, and the plan itself says 'skip if it adds nothing'. That leaves a listed deliverable whose status is unclear, which matters for criterion 6 ('only the listed deliverables changed'). Fix: Decide now. Either leave verify.rs untouched and say so in the change description, or add one sentence saying reuse_statement is not yet wired into the brief. Then the criterion 6 diff-stat check has a definite expected file set.

findings.summary: The test filter works only if the new test's name contains 'verifier_brief'.
findings.evidence: The filter `cargo test -p athena-context verifier_brief` only runs the new test if its name contains 'verifier_brief'. Fix: Name the new test with a 'verifier_brief' prefix, or run the test by its exact name.

summary: I read briefs.rs, verify.rs and the prompt files, and grepped for every place these prompts are loaded. The plan puts the fix where the problem starts. The verifier brief writes '## Checks Athena ran on this tree' (briefs.rs:461) and then lists each check, with no instruction about reruns. Adding a fixed paragraph right after that heading, plus matching rules in the verifier and reader prompts, deals with the cause: verifiers and readers pushing full-suite reruns. It does not change timeouts, the command allow-list or how checks run. Everything the plan names exists: VERIFIER_BRIEF_WITHOUT_A_PLAN at briefs.rs:1579, the byte-identical snapshot test, reuse_statement at verify.rs:57 (it has no caller, as the reading says), and both verifier.md files plus reader.md. The criterion 4 test checks where the text sits and that a failed check still reads 'failed', so it would fail without the change. That covers the outcome-check default: a failed recorded check still fails. The work fits one producer run. All remaining findings are minor: the shared brief and prompt also reach the study capability's verifiers, the crates whose prompts change are not all tested, and the verify.rs edit is optional.
